svg.title: OpenStreetMap AWS Cloud Architecture
svg.desc: A clean AWS architecture diagram for OpenStreetMap. It separates runtime traffic, private application and data tiers, managed platform services, and the GitHub Actions deployment workflow.
svg.text: A concise view of runtime traffic, private compute and data tiers, managed services, and CI/CD delivery.
Two Availability Zones with public, private application, and private data subnets
GitHub Actions validates infrastructure, builds the OpenStreetMap image, pushes to ECR, and deploys the ECS task definition.
Static SVG companion to docs/architecture.eraser. Service names map to Terraform resources in this repository.
